title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Plan Agreement: Plan Length and Monthly Installment
content:
## Payment plan agreement clause: plan length and installment

**Clause.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, a payment plan runs three months and its monthly installment is the balance due divided by the plan's months, rounded up to the cent.

### Terms of the clause

1. **Plan length.** 3 months. The plan never runs longer than the program's maximum plan length shown on the billing terms schedule.
2. **Amount financed.** The account's balance due on the handling date.
3. **Monthly installment.** The amount financed divided by the plan's months; only that quotient is rounded, and it is rounded up to the next whole cent, never down.

### Worked figures (hypothetical balances, 3-month plan)

| Balance due | Divided by 3 | Monthly installment |
|---|---|---|
| 300.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| 400.00 | 133.333 and so on | 133.34 |
| 251.00 | 83.666 and so on | 83.67 |
| 250.01 | 83.336 and so on | 83.34 |

### Points of judgement

- Rounding up means any fraction of a cent raises the installment to the next cent: 83.336 becomes 83.34.
- The quotient is rounded once; nothing is rounded before the division.
